apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: Calculator built entirely from host-rendered native controls. Reference app for the Native App SDK.

apps.name: Music
apps.description: Your own music library: import songs and videos, browse by artist and album, build playlists and playlist folders with covers, shuffle, repeat, queue, history, a full Now Playing view, and export.

apps.name: Books
apps.description: Your own e-book library: import EPUB books and CBZ comics, browse them as a bookshelf, sort them into collections, and read with adjustable themes, fonts and layout, a table of contents, bookmarks and a daily reading goal.
